### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

In PC/test_po_update.py, "test_po_update_io_no_loss" test, there are 2 pre-checks that happen. Currently the 2 pre-checks have messages swapped.
The skip messages needs to be corrected.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run "pc/test_po_update.py::test_po_update_io_no_loss" test with
1. no portchannels.
2. with portchannels having only 1 members

Sample command:
./run_tests.sh -n ptf2-m -c "pc/test_po_update.py::test_po_update_io_no_loss" -d xxxx -f ../ansible/testbed.yaml -i ../ansible/lab,../ansible/veos -t t0,any -u

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

**Actual Behavior**:

Currently upon running "pc/test_po_update.py::test_po_update_io_no_loss" test, we see following message:
1. no portchannels.
[skip reason] "Skip test due to there is no enough port channel with at least 2 members exists in current topology."
2. with portchannels having only 1 members
[skip reason] "Skip test as there are no port channels on asic {} on dut {}"

**Expected Behavior**:

Upon running "pc/test_po_update.py::test_po_update_io_no_loss" test, we should see following message:
1. no portchannels.
[skip reason] "Skip test as there are not enough port channels with members on asic {} on dut {}"
2. with portchannels having only 1 members
[skip reason] "Skip test as there are not enough port channels with at least 2 members in current topology."
